messages:
Maya Chen: Quick design review — sandbox preview feels cluttered when you have long rule stacks. Two main things I noticed: 1) drag handle + priority pin on the same line creates visual competition, 2) inline validation overlays the preview toggle at narrow widths (see screenshot: https://redwood.screens/IMG_0987). Thoughts on moving affordances and tightening copy? Kevin Li: I saw that too. My quick thought: move drag handle to the far left as primary affordance, keep pin on the right. Add a thin separator between rule body & controls so it reads left-to-right. Hover-only handle is fine for mouse but we need a keyboard fallback. Olivia Park: We should keep keyboard-first flow. If the drag handle disappears on hover, keyboard users lose the affordance — suggest an always-visible small chevron button with aria-label for reorder. Ryan O'Neal: A11y nits: warning yellow used for validation has poor contrast against white. Recommend using darker text or an icon+text pattern. Also validation overlays need role="alert" and an accessible link to the failing field. Preview toggle needs an aria-label that includes state (e.g., "Preview simulation, off"). Samir Gupta: Copy tweak suggestion: replace generic "Rule is invalid" with "Rule needs attention" + short reason line beneath. Example: Rule needs attention — Missing required condition: "user.region". And in the preview header add: "Simulated results — may differ from production traffic" (tooltip on hover). ux-bot: Automated layout checks: 14% of simulated runs show the validation overlay covering the preview toggle at <=768px; keyboard-only reorder coverage is 92% (goal 100%). Maya Chen: Thanks all — clear action items: I'll push an updated comp that separates controls and surfaces a persistent keyboard reorder button. Samir I'll adopt the copy change. Kevin can you prototype the keyboard affordance and the aria-live announcement pattern? Kevin Li: Yep, I'll prototype today. Plan: visible small reorder button with focus styles and a11y helpers. Also adding an aria-live region announcing "Rule moved to position X". Quick markup I plan to try: ```html
``` I'll post the storybook link when done. Ryan O'Neal: When you have it, I can run axe & color contrast checks. Also please make sure tooltip text is reachable by keyboard (focus on info icon). Olivia Park: Timeline check — can we aim to have the prototype + copy updates for design handoff by EOD Friday? That gives PMs time to review before sprint planning. Maya Chen: Sounds good. I'll upload updated comps to the Sandbox folder and tag everyone. Thanks! :raised_hands:
